# Dirty South’s App Lab

> Android closed-testing signup for Dirty South apps, plus a way for indie developers to list an app and for local businesses to request a custom Android build. Built by Dirty South Marketing Agency in Macon, GA.

Dirty South’s App Lab is at https://apps.dirtysouthagency.com/. These Android apps are in Google Play closed testing. The steps are the same for every app. There are no fake installs and no paid reviews.

Parent organization: Dirty South Marketing Agency (https://dirtysouthagency.com/), Macon and Warner Robins, Georgia.

## How testing works

Use the same Google account that is signed in on your phone’s Play Store for every step.

1. Join the App Lab tester Google Group (one group covers every app): https://groups.google.com/g/dirtysouth-app-lab-testers
2. Become a tester on the official Google Play opt-in page.
3. Wait a few minutes, then install the app from its Play Store link. The store page stays hidden until you have opted in.
4. Stay opted in, keep the app installed, and open it for about 1 minute every day during the 14-day closed test.

Google Play requires at least 12 testers to stay opted in for 14 consecutive days before a new personal developer account can apply for production. Uninstalling or leaving early can reset that clock. Joining a closed test and installing the app is free. Tests are Android only, through Google Play, and are not available on iPhone.

This site does not pay for installs, ratings, or Play Store reviews. It does not guarantee a tester count or Google’s approval.

## List your app

For indie Android developers who need 12 testers to stay opted in for 14 days before they can apply for Google Play production access. A listing includes an app card on App Lab, Google Group and opt-in steps, a live tester tracker, daily-open reminders, and a weekly feedback and bug report.

Founding offer: the first 20 apps are free, then $29 per app. App Lab recruits real testers. It does not guarantee a tester count or Google’s approval, and never pays for installs or reviews.

## Request an app (custom Android builds)

Dirty South’s App Lab can design and build a custom Android app for local small businesses and indie founders. Dreke is a solo Flutter developer in Middle Georgia (Macon / Warner Robins). The prices below are starting-at estimates for common scopes. A free consult comes first, then a written quote for the actual app. Work is Android-first; iOS can be quoted on request because the apps are built with Flutter. These estimates do not guarantee Google Play approval, a download count, or a search ranking.

Build tiers:

- Starter MVP: starting at $5,000. A focused first version of one core idea. A handful of screens, a clean layout, and submission to Google Play. One main flow, typically 5–10 screens; Android first, built with Flutter; Play Store listing and closed-test setup.
- Standard: starting at $20,000. An app with user accounts, a backend, and payments or subscriptions. Accounts and a hosted backend; payments or subscriptions; push notifications and a simple admin view.
- Advanced / AI: starting at $40,000. A more ambitious product: AI features, real-time updates, several user roles, or deeper integrations. Scoped before any quote is final.

Monthly management (starting-at estimates for time; hosting, APIs, and store fees are billed by those providers and are not included):

- Care: starting at $500/month. Bug fixes and crash follow-up, OS and dependency updates, help with hosting and service settings.
- Play Console & releases: starting at $1,000/month. Everything in Care, plus Play Console setup and management, store listing updates and scheduled releases, and closed-test setup for new versions.
- Growth: starting at $1,500/month. Everything in Play Console & releases, plus Play Store listing optimization (ASO), App Lab tester recruiting for new releases, and practical marketing support.
